source.description.zh-Hans: 看漫画的国漫书库有《斗罗大陆》《斗破苍穹》《穿越西元3000后》等长篇。部分章节需要付费。
source.description.zh-Hant: 看漫畫的中國漫畫書庫有《斗羅大陸》《鬥破蒼穹》《穿越西元3000後》等長篇。部分章節須付費。
source.description.en: Kanman's catalogue includes long-running Chinese series such as Soul Land, Battle Through the Heavens and Chuan Yue Xi Yuan 3000 Hou. Some chapters are paid.
